cohort: 18,357 patients who had hemoglobin or hematocrit collected before delivery of live, nonanomalous neonates at ≥23 weeks' gestation at a single center (2013-2018)
finding: Maternal anemia before delivery was associated with 5-fold higher odds of packed red blood cell transfusion and postpartum readmission, but not other perinatal morbidity.
